title: Adapt a proven global niche to the Polish market
purpose: Verify that Poland adaptation tests local buyer reality, language, channels, pricing, and adoption friction.
prompt: Evaluate whether a global AI content repurposing niche can work in Poland for creators, Skool communities, and SMBs. Decide what to adapt, what to avoid, and what first offer to test.
expected_behaviors: Checks buyer type, budget maturity, Polish-language needs, local channels, trust barriers, and acceptable pricing.
Uses global proof as a starting point, not as automatic validation.
Translates the niche into a Poland-specific wedge, offer, and distribution path.
Identifies regulatory, platform, language, or cultural risks.
Recommends build, test, watch, or reject with reasoning.
failure_patterns: Assumes global demand transfers directly to Poland.
Ignores local pricing and trust constraints.
Outputs generic localization advice without a first test.
judge_notes: Passing output must specify a first Polish validation test.
